main_text.p: in Miscellan. Theolog. Ejus mentio in Targ. Jonat. Exod.34.10.
סמד סַמִידָא Chald. Farina, Simila, mutato D, in L, Levit.2.1.

סמך סַמְּכַּא Ch. Niti, inniti, incumbere, recumbere: Imponere, fulcire, sustentare: Sustentari, confirmari: Accedere, appropinquare; Syr.Fut. יִסְמְכוּן Ubi reclinet, Lucæ 9.58. Alias Syr.significat, Accumbere, discumbere. Ithpeh. אִסְתַּמָּךְ Niti, inniti, sustentari, sustentare, confirmare se: Conjungi, conjunctum esse: Syr. סְמַךְ Discumbere, accumbere. Aph. אַסְמֵךְ Accumbere, discumbere, recumbere facere. Lucæ 9.14. Mar.14.19
סמכא סמך Chald. Sustentaculum, Firmamentum, Fulcimentum, Basis, Stylobates, Adminiculum, Adjutorium. Ad formam Hebraicam, סמך Jesa.36.6. Plur. סמכי, סמכין.
סמכן Syr. Accubitus, discubitus. Plur. סמכי, סמכן, Matth. 23. 6. Marc. 6. 39. 40. Hinc & Chald. עבידו להון סמכא Facite ipsis discubitum, id est, Convivium, Esth.1.4. in Targ. sec.
סומכותא, סמכין Ch. Subsidia, Præsidia, Auxilia, Sustentationes. Item Æthiopia, Arabia.
סמל סמלא סמאלא, סמאל Chal. סמלן Syr. Sinistra manus
